}}'''Archery''' is a tier two [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Archer]] [[unit]] and a [[Defence Bonus|defence bonus]] to friendly units on forest tiles. 

The [[Hoodrick]] [[Tribes|tribe]] starts with Archery.

For [[Polaris]], Archery unlocks the [[Ice Archer]],that freezes enemies instead of doing damage to them. For [[Cymanti]], Archery unlocks the [[Phychi]], a special unit with the ability to travel over water and poison enemy units but a low attack and health, and the defence bonus in forest.
